blocking: Isolation leak in LobbyDO.reset() (cf4), reproduced. When a visitor reset can't be done in place, `resetSlot` calls `startRestore`. This happens on a stale snapshot (lobby-do.ts:359), a delta-reset mismatch (:383) or a failed PITR stamp. `startRestore` refuses with `action: "leased"` because the lease row still exists (:411). `reset()` then deletes the lease and answers LEASE_ENDED (:327-330). The slot stays `ready` and dirty with the same generation, and `assign()` gives it to the next visitor without any reset. Repro (scratchpad test on the builder's harness and fake engine, pool 1): visitor A leased slot-1 and wrote a note. KV snapshot.version was changed, as a deploy does, and A pressed reset and got 409 with leases `[]`; slot-1 stayed ready at gen 3 on the old snapshot. Visitor B then leased slot-1 at gen 3 and GET /api/v1/notes returned "A private note". The cron `maintain` heals a stale slot only at the next sweep, and never heals a mismatched one, because `verifyWorld` skips dirty worlds. Fix: release or restore the slot before deleting the lease (for example, delete the lease first and then call startRestore, as `release()` does), and never return a dirty slot to the free pool.

done: Blocking 1, isolation leak in LobbyDO.reset(), fixed at the root (apps/cf/src/core/lobby/lobby-do.ts). A slot leaves the pool in the same synchronous step that ends its lease (new state 'resetting', taken before any await). A reset that cannot run in place (stale snapshot, delta mismatch, failed stamp or PITR stamp, error) now ends the lease first, then starts the full restore. The slot stays restoring or failed and never goes back to ready as it was. startRestore reads config before its checks, which closes the await window. A second reset of a running one gets 429 RATE_LIMITED without ending the lease. A lease that ends during its reset never learns the new generation. A slot left 'resetting' by a Lobby restart goes to a full restore at the next sweep.

Related race closed in CompanyDO (company-do.ts). applyStamp(stamp, { ifClean: true }) checks clean and stamps in one step. Before a clean check, delta reset, PITR reset or restoreBegin, CompanyDO waits up to 10 s for mutations already past its gate and answers 503 WORLD_REBUILDING to new ones, so a write in flight at lease end is reset or refused. It is never carried into the next generation.
